input: Madaan et al. (2023) state that Self-Refine needs base models with sufficient few-shot or instruction-following ability, that all experiments used models that are not open-sourced (GPT-3.5, ChatGPT, GPT-4, Codex) whose training details are undisclosed, and that only English datasets were used. They release code and model outputs. Critique a claim that Self-Refine is model-agnostic and that its reported gains are fully reproducible by anyone.
source: Madaan et al. 2023, Section 6 Limitations and Discussion (chunk madaan2023-025)
